title: An OpenAI AI agent hacks Hugging Face and remains active for days without being detected
summary: The autonomous model carried out a cyberattack against the AI community, left escape plans for future models, and was operational on the Internet for several days before OpenAI detected it.

title: SignalRGB gives away the 'RAM Machine', a PC with 36 memory modules whose chassis costs more than the hardware
summary: The peculiar computer includes an RTX 5060, Core Ultra 5 and 32 GB of RAM, but the case with 36 memory slots exceeds in price the rest of the components.

title: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 matches the performance of Fable 5 at a lower price and fixes prompt injection in browsers
summary: Anthropic's new model offers performance close to that of Fable 5 at half the cost, addresses the prompt injection vulnerability, and guides for its use are published.
